# Arcframe Docs

> Official documentation for Arcframe: engineering control plane for Cursor with local-first repository intelligence.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://arcframe.dev/docs/): What Arcframe is
- [Installation](https://arcframe.dev/docs/installation): Install and init
- [Quick Start](https://arcframe.dev/docs/quick-start): First index, graph, and MCP
- [MCP](https://arcframe.dev/docs/mcp): Cursor MCP server tools and resources
- [Arc Index](https://arcframe.dev/docs/arc-index): Incremental repository index
- [Arc Graph](https://arcframe.dev/docs/arc-graph): Dependency / import graph
- [Impact](https://arcframe.dev/docs/impact): Blast radius and impact analysis
- [SEO](https://arcframe.dev/docs/seo): Search positioning
